title: Tiger cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd38a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9a3c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 62,34 38,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 56,20 44,20' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <polygon points='50,20 56,32 44,32' fill='#4dd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='3.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='25' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='9' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='38' r='9' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fbf'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#ff8fbf'/>
  <!-- cheek fur tufts -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='7' fill='#fff2cf'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='62' r='7' fill='#fff2cf'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#fff2cf'/>
  <!-- stripes on forehead -->
  <path d='M42 40 L46 50' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58 40 L54 50' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 36 L50 48' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- stripes on cheeks -->
  <path d='M22 54 L30 56' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M78 54 L70 56' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='60' r='5.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='60' r='5.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='60' r='2.8' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='60' r='2.8' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M45 67 Q50 64 55 67 Q50 72 45 67 Z' fill='#ff6fa8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 71 Q50 76 44 76' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 71 Q50 76 56 76' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M34 88 L38 92' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M66 88 L62 92' stroke='#7a3b16' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='90' r='5' fill='#fff2cf'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='90' r='5' fill='#fff2cf'/>
</svg>
